Negative usable drawing width or height returns normally after seed selection/clear/reseed. Otherwise redraw loop clears layout and reruns stages but never reseeds or clears the stored room-rectangle list; random consumption continues from the prior prefix. No retry bound or termination proof.

Maze obtains visitable nodes before random starting-node selection and then reads its x/y. Empty visitable set fails before direction shuffling and subsequent room/decorative draws. No exact positive or zero random-channel consumption is inferred for native empty sample.

Checks occupied spacing only, not current floor terrain; success appends all event cells then returns bottom-left coordinate. Retained prior-redraw rectangles therefore remain conditional candidates; no actual bad seed or placement observed.
